title: Coastal Range > Tourism Administration, Republic of China (Taiwan)
description:
Sanxiantai’s Iconic Eight-Arch Bridge

A sinuous footbridge of eight arches stretches from the rocky Taiwanese shoreline out to a small offshore island, its red railings contrasting with the turquoise sea below. Dark volcanic rocks dot the shallow waters, where gentle waves break along the coast. In the distance, lush green hills rise toward misty mountain peaks under a sky streaked with white clouds.

This aerial perspective captures the unique geography of Sanxiantai, part of Taiwan’s Coastal Range. The bridge provides pedestrian access to the island, inviting visitors to explore tide pools and coastal flora. The vivid hues of the ocean, the rugged shoreline, and the verdant backdrop showcase the region’s dramatic natural scenery.
